title: OpenHAL hub protocol 2026-10-24
description: Generated from openhal/protocol/messages.py by python -m openhal.protocol.schema.

errors.name: PARSE_ERROR
errors.meaning: Invalid JSON

errors.name: INVALID_REQUEST
errors.meaning: Not a JSON-RPC request

errors.name: METHOD_NOT_FOUND
errors.meaning: Unknown method, or one above the hub's conformance level

errors.name: INVALID_PARAMS
errors.meaning: Params don't match the schema

errors.name: INTERNAL_ERROR
errors.meaning: A bug in the hub

errors.name: NOT_INITIALIZED
errors.meaning: hal/initialize hasn't run

errors.name: UNAUTHORIZED
errors.meaning: Missing or unknown token

errors.name: SCOPE_DENIED
errors.meaning: The principal's token scope doesn't cover this device or method

errors.name: UNKNOWN_TARGET
errors.meaning: No such device, channel or action

errors.name: DEVICE_UNAVAILABLE
errors.meaning: Disconnected or not ready

errors.name: LIMIT_EXCEEDED
errors.meaning: Outside the device file's confirmed limits

errors.name: RATE_LIMITED
errors.meaning: Faster than max_change_per_s allows right now

errors.name: INTERLOCK_BLOCKED
errors.meaning: An interlock or action requirement doesn't hold, or a value it needs is unknown

errors.name: CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED
errors.meaning: Queued for a person, data.requestId names the request

errors.name: STOPPED
errors.meaning: The hub is stopped until a person unlocks

errors.name: UNVERIFIED_LIMITS
errors.meaning: The device file's limits aren't confirmed by a person, so it is read-only

errors.name: INVALID_VALUE
errors.meaning: Wrong type, step, enum value or pattern

errors.name: WATCHDOG_TRIPPED
errors.meaning: A watchdog budget is used up

errors.name: BUSY
errors.meaning: Another command holds the device

errors.name: QUEUE_FULL
errors.meaning: The confirmation queue is full

errors.name: DRIVER_ERROR
errors.meaning: The device or its protocol failed, and the channel is unknown until a readback

errors.name: MISCONFIGURED
errors.meaning: The hub's device files are inconsistent, or a change would loosen a confirmed limit

errors.name: REQUEST_CLOSED
errors.meaning: The confirmation request expired or was rejected

errors.name: UNIT_INVALID
errors.meaning: A missing, unknown or incompatible unit, or a value that isn't finite
